President Daniel Ortega announced that Nicaragua will no longer hold elections, effectively canceling the 2027 vote and solidifying his nearly 20-year rule alongside his wife, Vice President Rosario Murillo.

The Poison:
The total elimination of electoral competition removes the last remaining safety valve for political dissent, increasing the likelihood of violent repression.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The error is in the WHY; the claim frames this as 'sovereignty' while the reality is 'fear of competition'. It is a classic bait-and-switch.

Social Physics Analysis:
This is a textbook example of power hoarding. By eliminating the possibility of a peaceful transfer of power, the regime forces all opposition into either exile or underground resistance, creating a high-strain, unstable system.

The Trajectory: The Path of Destruction.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. The removal of feedback loops guarantees systemic collapse.

The Unavoidable Truth: Ortega is terrified of losing his grip on power.

The Unavoidable Lie: Ending elections is a patriotic act to protect Nicaragua from foreign influence.
